rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The issue prints under 'Congresso Nacional' the letter to the President of the National Congress, dated Brasília 29 December 1992 and signed 'F. Collor', by which, on that date and by that instrument, he resigns the mandate of President of the Republic for which he was elected at the ballots of 15 November and 17 December 1989.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Senate's sentence as judicial body, dated Brasília 30 December 1992 and signed by Minister Sydney Sanches and the senators, recites that the session was suspended so that Congress could receive the resignation and declare the vacancy; that, the presidential mandate having been extinguished by the resignation, the process ended as to removal from office; and that, the two-thirds quorum having been reached, the Senate condemned him to disqualification ('inabilitação') for eight years from exercising public functions under Article 52, sole paragraph.

locator.item: SENADO FEDERAL COMO ÓRGÃO JUDICIÁRIO - SENTENÇA, items 1-5; items 6-11 and dating line on printed page 11172

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Resolução nº 101, de 1992, promulgated by the President of the Senate, Mauro Benevides, and dated Senado Federal 30 December 1992, declares the request for the sanction of loss of office prejudiced by the resignation presented and formalized before the National Congress, upholds the accusation of crimes of responsibility, imposes on Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello disqualification for eight years from exercising public functions, and enters into force on publication.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-10 only. Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, sash ceremony, authorization, summons, suspension, the Vice-President's exercise, resignation, vacancy, judgment, removal and disqualification stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Vice-presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded except the Vice-President's exercise of the office, recorded as rows only.
